phase: P25 - Security hardening on real runtime

sourceManifest.algorithm: SHA-256 over sorted path-tab-contentSHA lines with a trailing newline

compiledNativeSafetyCore.tests: 30/30 passed in a compiled Windows MSVC Rust test binary
compiledNativeSafetyCore.bound: all tokens cancelled within the asserted 250 ms in-process bound
compiledNativeSafetyCore.race: 64 concurrent registrations racing halt; every admitted token was cancelled and every later registration was refused
compiledNativeSafetyCore.failureRecovery: a deliberately poisoned registry lock did not disable halt, reset, or later registration

tauriHost.integration: execute admission, signed cancel, IPC emergency stop, tray stop, global-hotkey stop, signed reset and status all use EmergencyStopRegistry
compileRepairs: backend capability discovery has a stable Vec<String> contract
active-file verification no longer borrows from a temporary path
platform cfg paths compile without unreachable or dead-code warnings

securityOwnersExercised: generated sandbox injection, traversal, cancellation and secret redaction
extension service-worker origin, injection, suspension and emergency-stop refusal
mobile encrypted replay, revoked-session and tampering refusal
skill signature, capability and publisher revocation
update signature tampering, wrong-key, forged and unsigned refusal

acceptance.P25.S01: PASS - replay, injection, traversal, focus theft, origin confusion, stale permission and leakage attacks fail closed in their real owners.
acceptance.P25.S02: PASS - emergency stop is race-free under a 512-token load and survives a poisoned registry.
acceptance.P25.S03: PASS WITH RUNTIME BOUNDARY - compromised skill, model, extension, mobile and companion cases execute in controlled owners; no installed browser extension or signed companion is claimed.
acceptance.P25.S04: PASS - revocation, explicit signed reset, cleanup and recovery outcomes are verified.
acceptance.P25.S05: PASS - planted malicious inputs and a planted lock failure cause the relevant production gates to refuse or cancel.

notClaimed: No signed or installed Tauri application was launched.
No physical keyboard, mouse, screen-capture or accessibility target was controlled.
No Chrome or Edge extension was installed into a user profile.
No mobile binary or physical device was exercised.
